scope: Execution and transport queue correlation, operator close and guarded requeue in local and authenticated remote workbenches
implemented: Queue filters, pagination, payloads, physical parts and receipts, immutable review audit and bidirectional execution navigation
Compare-and-set revisions and stable action identities; repeated RPCs do not repeat queue transitions
Audit evidence and queue changes commit together; closing preserves physical state and prevents worker or direct delivery
Successful parts are preserved; unknown parts require explicit per-part confirmation of non-delivery before requeue
Accepted incomplete inbound executions cannot be rerun via queue controls
Active work, changed outbound accounts and unready senders block review retry
Structured Telegram inbound account identities are checked during consumption and operator retry
Open linked outbound work or successful receipts prohibit execution-level no-effect clearance and first whole-turn retry

backend_full_suite.scope: Complete run before the final inbound-account guard and three added regression cases. The changed paths were then verified by the targeted suite below; no claim of a new full run after that guard.

final_targeted_suite.skip_reason: Existing POSIX SIGTERM process test is unavailable on Windows

assertions: unknown parts not silently marked delivered

remote: repeat close after reconnect is idempotent
two-client retry/close race has one winner
queue receipts prevent false execution clearance

boundaries: The queue database remains an independent mutable authority; audit evidence is not a complete event-sourced transport runtime
Original Telegram updates may contain commands and are inspect/close only in this phase
Operator confirmation is not a physical receipt and cannot guarantee external exactly-once delivery
Closing an execution or queue job does not silently close other linked records
Historical correlations without stable identities are not inferred from text or timestamps
Active-flow event sourcing, model-context projection and controlled continuation remain subsequent phases
